cinderlink.configuration.title: CinderLink
cinderlink.configuration.hosting.tooltip: How your world is opened to friends over the internet.
cinderlink.configuration.enableUpnp.tool: Ask your router to open the port while you host. It's closed again when you stop.
cinderlink.configuration.enableIpv6.tool: Offer friends an IPv6 address when your connection has one.
cinderlink.configuration.friends.tooltip: Your friends list and who can see your worlds.
cinderlink.configuration.enableFriends.t: Use the friends list. Turned off, CinderLink makes no network connections at all.
cinderlink.configuration.showHostingToas: Pop up a notification when a friend starts hosting.
cinderlink.hosting.opening: Opening your world to your friends...
cinderlink.hosting.offline_mode: Hosting for friends needs a logged-in Minecraft account so CinderLink can verify who's joining. Opened to LAN only.
cinderlink.problem.upnp_disabled: UPnP is turned off in CinderLink's settings.
cinderlink.problem.no_upnp_router: Your router didn't answer. UPnP may be turned off in the router's settings.
cinderlink.problem.router_refused: Your router refused to open the port.
cinderlink.problem.cgnat: Your internet provider shares one public address between customers (CGNAT), so port mapping can't work.
cinderlink.problem.double_nat: Your router sits behind another router, so port mapping can't reach the internet.
cinderlink.problem.ipv6_disabled: IPv6 is turned off in CinderLink's settings.
cinderlink.problem.no_ipv6: This connection has no IPv6 internet address.
cinderlink.join.not_allowed: This world is only open to friends the host has picked.
cinderlink.lan.friends.tooltip: Who on your CinderLink friends list can see and join this world. Picked fresh every time.
cinderlink.lan.choose.tooltip: Pick which friends can see and join this world.
cinderlink.picker.title: Who can join?
cinderlink.picker.empty: No friends yet. Add some from the Friends screen.
cinderlink.hosting.visible_to: Your world is open to %s friend(s). They can join from their friends list.
cinderlink.hosting.no_friends_picked: No friends were picked, so nobody can see this world. Invite them from the Friends screen.
cinderlink.hosting.invite_only: Invite-only: open the Friends screen and press Invite next to a friend.
cinderlink.hosting.lan_friends_only: Only friends on your own network can join right now:
cinderlink.hosting.friends_off: The CinderLink friends list is off or still starting, so the world was opened to LAN only.
cinderlink.friends.title: Friends
cinderlink.friends.status.disabled: The friends list is turned off in CinderLink's settings.
cinderlink.friends.status.network: Can't reach the friends network from here. This network may block it.
cinderlink.friends.status.startup: The friends list couldn't start. Check latest.log for details.
cinderlink.friends.copy_code.tooltip: Copies your Cinder Code. Send it to someone so they can add you. It isn't an address and can't be used to find you.
cinderlink.friends.reset_code.tooltip: Makes a new code. Old codes stop working; your friends stay.
cinderlink.friends.none: No friends yet. Use Add Friend or share your code.
cinderlink.friends.pending.hint: Waiting for them to accept. They need to be online.
cinderlink.remove.title: Remove %s?
cinderlink.remove.body: You'll stop seeing each other's status. To be friends again, one of you sends a new request.
cinderlink.block.title: Block %s?
cinderlink.block.body: Their requests will be ignored from now on.
cinderlink.reset.title: Reset your Cinder Code?
cinderlink.reset.body: Every code you've shared stops working. Your current friends aren't affected.
cinderlink.add.title: Add a Friend
cinderlink.add.help: Paste the Cinder Code your friend sent you.
cinderlink.add.not_running: The friends list isn't running yet.
cinderlink.add.result.invalid_code: That isn't a valid Cinder Code. Check that you copied all of it.
cinderlink.add.result.already_sent: You've already sent them a request.
cinderlink.toast.request.title: Friend request
cinderlink.toast.accepted.title: New friend
cinderlink.toast.hosting.title: %s is hosting
cinderlink.toast.copied.title: Cinder Code copied
cinderlink.toast.copied: Send it to a friend so they can add you
cinderlink.toast.sent.title: Request sent
cinderlink.toast.sent: They'll see it next time they're online
cinderlink.join.leave.title: Leave your world?
cinderlink.join.leave.body: Your world will be saved and closed so you can join %s.
cinderlink.join.failed.title: Couldn't join
cinderlink.join.failed: %s's world couldn't be reached. Their network may block incoming connections.
